notes: אֶל־מוּל is split rather than fused: each morpheme holds an English word of its own (in / front), so rule 2 governs and rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet. The fusion reading is named on the unit.
פָּנָיו and its suffix are unrepresented, the ASV writing the bare in front.
did he set keeps the inversion auxiliary and subject pronoun with the verb (rule 17); no interrogative morpheme stands in the clause.
